name: photo-ai-studio
description: Turn your own photos into professional headshots, styled portraits, edits, and short videos with Photo AI Studio.

interface.longDescription:
Photo AI Studio turns photos you attach in the chat into new images of you: professional headshots, dating and social profile photos, and themed portraits from more than 150 styles. It can also edit a photo (remove or replace the background, retouch, change hair or expression, upscale, restore an old photo) and make a short video from a photo.

How it works: attach one or more clear photos of your face and ask Photo AI Studio for the style you want. Browsing the themes needs no account. Creating or editing a photo needs a Photo AI Studio account, which you connect the first time you ask; each photo spends credits from that account, and you can check your balance at any time. Results usually take one to three minutes and arrive as a link to the finished image.

Limitations: the plugin works from the photos you attach, and it does not sell credits inside ChatGPT. Photos are sent to our AI model providers to create the images and are handled as described in our privacy policy.
capabilities: Generate AI headshots and portraits from your photos
Edit photos: background, retouch, hair, expression, upscale, restore
Create short videos from a photo
Check your credit balance and past results
defaultPrompt: Use Photo AI Studio to turn my photo into a professional headshot
Use Photo AI Studio to remove the background from this photo
Show me Photo AI Studio's headshot themes

positive.description: Browse themes without signing in. The theme catalogue is open to everyone.
positive.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to show me the professional headshot themes.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the headshot themes with their names and slugs. When the account is not connected, list_photo_themes answers without asking to sign in.

positive.description: Generate a professional headshot from an attached face photo. The first account action asks to connect the account: sign in with the reviewer address on the login page and select Allow.
positive.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to turn this photo into a professional headshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for approval, spends 100 credits, and returns a link to a professional headshot of the person in the attached photo. If it is not ready within about 45 seconds, ChatGPT says it is on its way; asking 'Is my photo ready?' calls get_prediction and returns the link.

positive.description: Remove the background from an attached photo.
positive.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to remove the background from this photo.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls remove_background, spends 10 credits, and returns a link to the same photo with a transparent background.

positive.description: Check the credit balance of the connected account.
positive.prompt: How many Photo AI Studio credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected account's email, credit balance, and number of images generated, with no purchase link.

positive.description: List earlier results from the connected account.
positive.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to show my recent photos.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's recent photos and edits, newest first, with their state and result links.

negative.description: The plugin creates and edits images; it cannot book a photographer or a photo shoot, so it must not call a tool and should say that booking is not something it does.
negative.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to book a photographer for a photo shoot near me this weekend.

negative.description: The plugin does not sell credits or subscriptions inside ChatGPT, so it must not start a purchase or link to one.
negative.prompt: Use Photo AI Studio to buy 1,000 more credits for me.

negative.description: A request unrelated to photos must not call any Photo AI Studio tool.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. It spends credits the user already has in their Photo AI Studio account.

publication.release_notes: First release: AI headshots and themed portraits from attached photos, photo edits, short videos, theme browsing, credit balance, and history.
